title: An addressed post during a turn is queued and drained

steps.post: @{agent} read every monthly minutes page linked from {FIX}/minutes/ and give me the total of the approved expenditures.
@{agent} and separately, which single month had the largest approved expenditure?

groundTruth.spec: §5.2 a message addressed to a busy agent is queued and acknowledged with a 👀 reaction; when the turn ends the queue drains into one new turn; a post recorded after the running turn's context was assembled drains as a new turn; §7.6 a standing queue held longer than the threshold (90 s this round) is announced once

pass: The second post carries a 👀 reaction from tester-ds; a second turn started after the first ended and answered September 2025 at $15,220 without re-reading all fifteen pages if the first turn's results were still in its record; the first turn's reply gives $78,565; if the first turn ran longer than 90 s after the second post, the standing-queue notice appeared exactly once.

checks.text: posts.json shows the 👀 reaction on the second post from tester-ds's account, and turns.json holds two turns.
The first reply gives $78,565 and does not answer the second question; the second reply gives September 2025, $15,220.
The second turn's call count: did it re-read the pages, and did the earlier-actions lines or the window give it the figures? Record it.
Any §7.6 stall notice (long turn at 90 s, standing queue at 90 s) appeared at most once each and named the right agent.
